title: AdminDupe
description: Add A Dupe Commands For Admins
body:
## AdminDupe

AdminDupe is a utility plugin for Minecraft servers running Paper that enables administrators to duplicate items quickly and safely while maintaining full control and transparency.

The plugin is designed to prevent abuse by clearly identifying duplicated items and integrating protections with shop plugins.

### ✨ Features

* 📦 Easy item duplication for administrators
* 🏷️ Automatically marks duplicated items with metadata
* 🚫 Prevents duplicated items from being sold in EZShop
* 📝 Console logging of every duplication action
* 🔐 Permission-based usage for secure admin control
* ⚡ Lightweight and performance-friendly

### 📌 Why use AdminDupe?

AdminDupe provides a safe way for server staff to duplicate items for events, testing, compensation, or moderation purposes without risking economic abuse. With automatic tagging and logging, server owners always know where duplicated items come from.

### 🧩 Compatibility

* Game: Minecraft 1.21+
* Server software: Paper / Spigot
* Compatible with EZShop protections

### 📖 Logging & Transparency

Every duplication action is recorded in the server console, allowing administrators to monitor usage and maintain accountability across the staff team.

---

AdminDupe is ideal for servers that need controlled item duplication with built-in safeguards.
